items.title: Rename package metadata for published packages
items.context: Change package.json and package-lock names/dependencies from @koala-agent/* to @lattice-agent/* for core/utils/lab/cli packages, and update root package identity where it exposes Koala branding. Keep the lattice binary primary and preserve koala bin aliases only as legacy compatibility.
items.userSees: Metadata checks print "@lattice-agent/core 0.3.5" and a package scope scan prints "package metadata scope check passed"; the `koala` bin remains visible only as a legacy alias.

happy.desc: Inspect root and workspace package manifests plus lockfiles and confirm published package names use @lattice-agent/*, especially packages/main name @lattice-agent/core at version 0.3.5.

edge.desc: Confirm package bin metadata keeps lattice as the primary command while koala remains only as an explicit legacy compatibility alias, with no accidental removal of existing CLI access.

adversarial.desc: Run a package metadata scan that fails if any manifest or lockfile dependency still presents @koala-agent/* as a canonical package scope rather than a deliberate legacy bin alias or historical repository URL.

verificationEvidence.note: Verified root package name is lattice, packages/main remains @lattice-agent/core 0.3.5, and packages/game is @lattice/game with matching lockfile roots.
Verified bin.lattice remains primary and legacy bin.koala remains mapped to dist/cli.js.

verificationEvidence.command: rg package metadata for @koala/game and mistaken root @lattice/game
verificationEvidence.note: No package manifest or lockfile still has @koala/game, and root package.json/package-lock.json are not named @lattice/game.

items.title: Update runtime and bootstrap package resolution
items.context: Runtime checks, worktree relink, init bootstrap, prompt registry, rollout checks, and generated local wrappers currently hard-code @koala-agent/core paths. Update them to resolve @lattice-agent/core as canonical while treating @koala-agent/core as legacy fallback only where existing projects need compatibility.
items.userSees: `lattice doctor` and related runtime diagnostics show "@lattice-agent/core" as the canonical package; if "@koala-agent/core" appears, the output labels it as legacy compatibility.

happy.desc: Run runtime diagnostics or focused assertions and confirm global/local package resolution prefers @lattice-agent/core for doctor, worktree relink, init bootstrap, prompt registry, rollout checks, and adapter checks.

edge.desc: Simulate or inspect the compatibility path where only @koala-agent/core is present and confirm it is treated as a bounded legacy fallback with diagnostic wording that names it legacy, not canonical.

adversarial.desc: Search updated runtime/bootstrap code and generated prompt templates to prove no new canonical resolver, wrapper, diagnostic, or template import still points first to @koala-agent/core.

verificationEvidence.note: TypeScript build passed after runtime/bootstrap code started preferring @lattice-agent/core.

verificationEvidence.command: node -e external project runRuntimeEnvironmentChecks with only global @koala-agent/core symlink
verificationEvidence.note: Runtime global-core-realpath passed when legacy @koala-agent/core resolved to the expected core realpath and emitted a legacy compatibility fallback warning.

verificationEvidence.command: rg scan for @koala-agent/core/dev-host, old prompt registry, and unlabelled canonical @koala-agent package assertions
verificationEvidence.note: No generated prompt template import or canonical resolver/template assertion points first to @koala-agent/core; remaining @koala-agent/core references are labelled legacy fallback paths.
Codex adapter checks passed 6/7 with the only warning explicitly labelling global @koala-agent/core as legacy fallback heartbeat-only evidence.

items.title: Refresh docs and verification contract references
items.context: User-facing and process docs should stop presenting @koala-agent/core as the canonical package name. Update active truth-source docs and verification scripts that assert old package names, without touching docs/story or fixture JSON directly.
items.userSees: README and active requirement docs show "@lattice-agent/core" as the current package; `rg "@koala-agent/core" README.md docs/requirements/decisions scripts packages/main/src` returns only legacy-labelled or historical matches.

happy.desc: Review README and active truth-source docs and confirm current install/runtime package guidance names @lattice-agent/core as canonical instead of @koala-agent/core.

edge.desc: Confirm retained Koala references in active docs are explicitly framed as legacy compatibility, historical context, repository URLs, or command aliases, not as the current npm package identity.

adversarial.desc: Run a focused search across README, active requirement docs, verification scripts, and active runtime sources that fails if @koala-agent/core is still asserted as canonical or protected by verification scripts.

verificationEvidence.command: node -e active docs package scope check over README.md and authority-client-role.md
verificationEvidence.note: README and authority-client-role current package guidance include @lattice-agent/core as canonical.

verificationEvidence.command: node -e legacy package reference labelling check
verificationEvidence.note: Retained @koala-agent/core references in active docs/scripts/runtime paths are explicitly labelled legacy fallback or compatibility.

verificationEvidence.command: if rg -n old canonical @koala-agent/core assertions in README, active authority doc, scripts, packages/main/src, and templates; then exit 1; else echo canonical package assertion scan passed; fi
verificationEvidence.note: Focused scan found no old @koala-agent/core canonical install/runtime/template assertions.
Runtime fact contract now guards @lattice-agent/core as canonical with bounded @koala-agent/core fallback; process fact contract still passes.

items.title: Verify package rename behavior
items.context: Run targeted package metadata checks, TypeScript/build verification, existing runtime contract verification scripts, and lattice validate so the rename does not break local wrappers, lab registration, or runtime environment diagnostics.
items.userSees: Terminal evidence shows package metadata checks passed, `npm --prefix packages/main run build` passed, runtime contract scripts passed, and `lattice validate --story=B-50fb` reports pass/allPass true for B-50fb.

happy.desc: Run a targeted metadata assertion and repo-standard build or typecheck to prove @lattice-agent/* package metadata, dependency edges, and generated lock metadata are internally consistent after the rename.

edge.desc: Run existing runtime contract checks, including entrypoint/global lab verification and verify_codex when adapter assets or prompt templates changed, to prove wrappers and adapter diagnostics still work with canonical package names.

adversarial.desc: Run lattice validate --story=B-50fb after implementation evidence is recorded and confirm it passes only with fresh verificationEvidence covering CHK-001 through CHK-004, with no stale package rename evidence accepted.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm --prefix packages/lab run build && npm --prefix packages/utils run build
verificationEvidence.note: Main, lab, and utils TypeScript builds passed under @lattice-agent package names.

verificationEvidence.command: node scripts/verify-entrypoints.mjs && node scripts/verify-global-lab-entrypoint.mjs && node scripts/verify-runtime-fact-contract.mjs && node bin/lattice.js verify_codex
verificationEvidence.note: Entrypoints, global lab metadata/bootstrap behavior, runtime fact contract, and Codex adapter verification passed; verify_codex labels old global @koala-agent/core as legacy fallback.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:validation-protocol && npm --prefix packages/main run test:rollout-check-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Runtime validation protocol and rollout/self-layout smoke tests passed after package-scope rename.
Story validation passed after CHK-001 through CHK-004 evidence was recorded: project fallback npm test passed and verification intent coverage was 12/12.
